classification_policy.a_existing_evidence_automation: The retained official evidence already fixes the relevant semantics; deterministic, source-bound evaluator or projection work can close this blocker without adding a substantive fact.
classification_policy.b_new_official_source_capture: The retained evidence does not publish or reproducibly retain the closed roster, attribute, destination choice, or topology required by the computation.
classification_policy.c_human_institutional_verification: The official evidence conflicts, delegates the decision, or requires an independent/current verification signature; code or another scrape of the same wording cannot select one truth safely.
classification_policy.fail_closed_rule: A blocker is not class a merely because a plausible minimum plan can be constructed. Existing evidence must determine the complete feasible set or prove exact zero Figure 3/4 impact.
